name: armis-knowledge-skills-dev
description: DEV environment (knowledge-api.moose-dev.armis.com). Adds /knowledge-dev, /cwe-fix-dev, /framework-guidance-dev, and /tech-guidance-dev as shell skills that call the backend directly. Reads ARMIS_KNOWLEDGE_CLIENT_ID; loads client_secret from the OS keychain (service: armis-knowledge-dev). Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.
